cost_convention: breakout_research.backtest.backtester._apply_costs (slippage on the execution price, taker fee on the slippage-adjusted notional); position fully invested from the first bar's open of the fold window and flattened at the last bar's close
sharpe_convention: daily returns aligned by UTC calendar day (last equity value of the day), annualized on a 365-day calendar with the sample standard deviation
